seo.title: Integrations - Slack, Webhooks, and More
seo.description: Connect OpenPanel to Slack, Discord, webhooks, and more. Trigger actions based on user behavior-send alerts, sync to Zapier, or export events to S3 and BigQuery.

hero.heading: Integrations: connect to any webhook
hero.subheading: Push data out of OpenPanel and into Slack, Discord, or any webhook. Trigger on the events you choose, with no polling and no glue code.

related_features.title: Notifications
related_features.description: Notification rules control when integrations fire. Define events, filters, and templates - then attach integrations to act on them.

related_features.title: Event tracking
related_features.description: Integrations are powered by the events you track. The richer your event data, the more precise your triggers can be.

related_features.title: Funnels
related_features.description: Trigger integrations when a user completes an entire funnel - not just a single event.

items.question: How do integrations and notifications work together?
items.answer: Integrations are the destinations (Slack channel, webhook URL, Discord server). Notification rules are the triggers (when event X happens with filter Y). You create both, then attach integrations to rules. When a rule fires, all attached integrations receive the data.

items.question: Can I use webhooks with Zapier, Make or n8n?
items.answer: Yes. Create a Webhook integration with the catch URL those tools give you. There is no native Zapier app; the generic webhook is the way in, and the JavaScript transform lets you shape the payload the way the receiving step expects.

items.question: What does the JavaScript transform do?
items.answer: The JavaScript transform is a function that receives the raw event payload and returns a modified version. You can rename fields, filter out properties, add computed values, or completely restructure the data. It runs before the payload is sent to the webhook URL.

items.question: What do the S3 and GCS exports contain?
items.answer: Raw events as gzipped JSON lines, written to your bucket every 60 seconds under the prefix you choose. S3 Export works with AWS S3 and S3-compatible storage such as Cloudflare R2 and MinIO through the endpoint URL; GCS Export writes to Google Cloud Storage. Load the files into Snowflake, BigQuery, Athena, Redshift or DuckDB.

items.question: Can one integration be used by multiple notification rules?
items.answer: Yes. An integration is just a connection to a service. You can attach it to as many notification rules as you want. For example, a single Slack integration can be triggered by rules for signups, purchases, and errors - each with its own template and filters.

items.question: Is there a limit to how many integrations I can create?
items.answer: There's no hard limit. Create as many integrations and notification rules as you need to cover your workflows.

items.question: Can I import data from another tool?
items.answer: Yes. Settings › Imports pulls events from Mixpanel and Amplitude through their export APIs (with US or EU residency), and from Umami through an exported file. The import history shows progress and lets you retry.
